title: Update Button Component Size Variants
description: Modify the button component's size variants in the cva configuration to increase the default button size with larger padding and height
details: Navigate to `components/ui/button.tsx` and locate the `buttonVariants` constant defined with `cva`. In the `variants.size` object, update the 'default' size variant from current values (likely `h-10 px-4 py-2`) to larger dimensions such as `h-12 px-6 py-3`. Also consider increasing font size from `text-sm` to `text-base` for better visual prominence. Ensure all size variants maintain proper proportional relationships and follow Tailwind's spacing scale.
test_strategy: Visual inspection of the button component in isolation and within the Storybook or component playground if available. Verify that all button states (default, hover, focus, active, disabled) render correctly with the new dimensions.

title: Verify Layout Integrity Across Key Pages
description: Test the updated button component across all critical application pages to ensure the larger size doesn't break existing layouts
details: Systematically check the following pages: landing page (`app/page.tsx`), sign-in page (`app/sign-in/page.tsx`), sign-up page (`app/sign-up/page.tsx`), and dashboard (`app/dashboard/page.tsx`). Look for layout issues such as buttons overflowing containers, text wrapping unexpectedly, or elements overlapping. Pay special attention to form layouts, modal dialogs, and any horizontally constrained areas. Test on different viewport sizes (desktop, tablet, mobile) to ensure responsive design integrity.
test_strategy: Manual visual testing across multiple screen sizes using browser developer tools. Create a checklist of all pages containing buttons and systematically verify each one. Take screenshots before and after changes for comparison if needed.

title: Cross-Browser Compatibility Testing
description: Verify that the updated button styles render consistently across major web browsers and perform final quality assurance
details: Test the updated button component in Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge to ensure consistent rendering. Check that the new button dimensions, padding, and font sizes display correctly across browsers. Verify that all interactive states (hover effects, focus rings, active states) work properly. Also test keyboard navigation to ensure accessibility is maintained with the larger button size. Document any browser-specific issues and apply fixes if necessary.
test_strategy: Cross-browser manual testing using actual browsers or browser testing tools. Create a simple test matrix covering button states across different browsers. Verify keyboard navigation and screen reader compatibility if accessibility tools are available.
